items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: Yeah, Johnny Sabo. He was quite a guy. Quite a good one.

ctx.x: Yeah, Johnny Sabo. He was quite a guy. Quite a good one. This was from Lou Forbes. I still see his cousins, I guess, or brothers.
So you say Lou Forbes had the band in there until it closed then, huh? When did it close? What year?
